name: Symmachean Paladins
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry (Sword & Shield) · shields · 235 leadership · T4 · Mastery
pitch: A shielded sustain-tank that lives on its unique heal and rewards X+V animation-canceling for extra DPS when it's safe to drop block. Cavalry and maul-wielding heroes are its hard counter, punished further by a 20% back-hit weak spot everyone already plays around.

doctrines.name: Anti-Infantry Doctrine V
doctrines.note: +200 dmg to infantry, +250 block — swap for an LS doctrine if more sustain is needed

doctrines.name: Block-Increase Doctrine
doctrines.note: close to mandatory when paired with piercing-damage doctrine slots

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Average 1.68% heal per second, more offensive nodes, cooldown reduction on the bleed skill.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Average 1.2% heal per second, more defensive nodes, more armor, plus roughly 10% rare-attack damage reduction and extra block — deliberately defensive, built against maul "crunching."

battleRole.positioning: Don't charge in unless you have significant front-line support — going alone stacks the enemy against you. Use the heal to disengage and reset: take aggro, pop the bleed skill, disengage, heal, repeat. {2}
battleRole.formation: Block/shield-wall (F2) for both charging and holding while attacking — but charging from this tight formation exposes the whole unit to hero CC chains (e.g. maul dismount-stun into a short-sword follow-up). Charging from the spread formation (F1) instead trades a little charge damage for CC safety and still naturally surrounds the target on landing. {2}
battleRole.tips: X+V cancel: press V the instant an X-move lands damage, then repeat — cancels most of the attack animation for higher DPS, but every X drops the unit's block. Only run this when free of threats; against big enemy numbers, hold V alone (auto-fight/counter-attack stance) since it never drops block. {1}{2} Cancel the heal (skill 2) with an instant V-press right after — the heal still resolves. {1} Weak Spot: back hits take 20% bonus damage and opponents actively play around it; the bottom-line veterancy cuts that to roughly 10%. {2}

cards.name: Pikes
cards.why: this unit counters pikes, per Amya

cards.name: Cavalry
cards.why: can stun-lock the unit to death if not managed; struggles vs cav per Amya too

cards.name: Maul-wielding heroes
cards.why: dismount-stun chains lock down the whole unit, especially while charging in tight formation

controls.notes: Symmachean Brotherhood — models attack on slow, non-simultaneous timing, which is what makes the X+V cancel pattern possible but also means every X-move drops block. {2} Auto-fight on V (counter-attack stance) is the safer default vs large enemy numbers — slower kill, less damage taken. {1}{2} Heal ability is unique for also healing nearby allied units and heroes (5% max health per tick, on top of the ~250 HP/s standard regen most units get). {2}

gaps: House sources rate Paladins a doctrine-investment priority in both regular and purple metas {3} and place it in a farm-worthy attack-tier row {4}, but give no doctrine specifics beyond Amya/HandBananaPvP above — investment signal only, not build guidance.
